title: Establishment of a 5G NAS security context during N1 mode to N1 mode handover

entities.name: N1 mode to N1 mode handover security context establishment
entities.description: Procedure for establishing a new 5G NAS security context during N1 mode to N1 mode handover, which may use the same KAMF or a new KAMF.

entities.name: Intra N1 mode NAS transparent container IE
entities.description: Information element containing security parameters including 8 LSBs of downlink NAS COUNT, ngKSI, message authentication code, and NAS algorithms.

entities.name: SECURITY MODE COMMAND message
entities.description: Message used to activate new security context over non-3GPP access when UE is in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode.

entities.name: REGISTRATION ACCEPT message
entities.description: Message that triggers activation of new security context over non-3GPP access when UE is in 5GMM-IDLE mode.

entities.name: 5G NAS security context
entities.description: Security context containing KAMF, NAS COUNTs, ngKSI, and NAS algorithms.

entities.name: NAS COUNT
entities.description: Counter used for NAS security, with separate uplink and downlink values.

entities.name: KAMF
entities.description: Anchor key for AMF used in 5G NAS security context derivation.

entities.name: ngKSI
entities.description: Key set identifier for 5G NAS security context.

entities.name: New KAMF derivation indicated
entities.description: Condition where Intra N1 mode NAS transparent container IE indicates that a new KAMF needs to be derived.

entities.name: Valid NAS COUNT
entities.description: Condition where received NAS COUNT in Intra N1 mode NAS transparent container IE is valid.

entities.name: NAS MAC verified successfully
entities.description: Condition where message authentication code in Intra N1 mode NAS transparent container IE is verified successfully.

entities.name: 5GMM-IDLE mode
entities.description: NAS state where UE is registered but has no active signaling connection.

entities.name: 5GMM-CONNECTED mode
entities.description: NAS state where UE has an active signaling connection.

relations.description: Handover procedure uses Intra N1 mode NAS transparent container IE to convey security parameters.
IE indicates whether new KAMF derivation is required.
When new KAMF is indicated, NAS COUNTs are set to zero.
Valid NAS COUNT condition guards acceptance of new security context.
Successful NAS MAC verification guards acceptance of new security context.
In 5GMM-IDLE mode, REGISTRATION ACCEPT message triggers security context activation.
In 5GMM-CONNECTED mode, SECURITY MODE COMMAND message activates security context.
SECURITY MODE COMMAND message includes ngKSI to identify security context.
Intra N1 mode NAS transparent container IE includes ngKSI.
Intra N1 mode NAS transparent container IE includes 8 LSBs of downlink NAS COUNT.
